digest.component_or_area: metrics/blame and bug closure caused_by derivation
propositions: Clone guidance documentation must record measured size and time tradeoffs (full 1.04 GiB / 59 s vs blobless 68.7 MiB / 14.3 s) and warn that --filter=tree:0 is unsuitable (3.57 GiB)
_blame_file_commits currently returns [] for both git failure and successful-but-empty results, making failure undetectable; it must distinguish by returning None on failure and [] on empty success
derive_caused_by can produce wrong caused_by links when blame succeeds on some paths and fails on others, causing strict-majority tally to run over a subset instead of full set
derive_caused_by must abort and return None on any per-path blame failure (None return from _blame_file_commits), while legitimately empty blame results ([] return) must not abort derivation
Files with zero blame lines must not trigger abort or cause missing caused_by event to be written
